descriptionChirho: A solemn sworn declaration or binding promise, often invoking God as witness; used of both human oaths (e.g., Herod's rash oath, Matt 14:7,9) and divine oaths (God's covenant oath to Abraham, Luke 1:73). The singular and plural forms represent the same core meaning of a binding sworn commitment. Multilingual evidence: spa 'juramento/juramentos' (oath/oaths), hin 'शपथ/शपथोन' (shapath, solemn vow), arb 'قَسَمٍ/الأَقْسَامِ' (qasam/aqsām, oath/oaths from same root ق-س-م), kor '맹세/맹세들' (maengse, oath), swa 'kiapo/viapo' (oath sg/pl, same stem).
